clues: This town is in the Free State in South Africa. It lies southwest of the city of Bloemfontein.
Winters here are extremely cold. The air often drops below freezing in that season here.
This is the second oldest town in the Free State. Its long history sets it apart from newer towns all around.
A railway line runs right down the middle of the main road. Only three towns in the whole world share this odd sight.
The National Equestrian Endurance Race comes here each year. Horse and rider teams need three hard days to finish it.
